sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions do not allow capitalisation of penal charges or penal interest, and they say there shall be no further interest computed on such charges.
The same directions also say that additional or fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
So the question’s premise that RBI now allows penal interest to be capitalised is not supported by the in-force evidence for this bank.
The bank’s own home-loan form says the levy of penal charges shall not affect the normal procedure for compounding of interest on the loan, but it does not permit compounding penal interest.
